title: WPSS/1097/2015 of Govind Singh Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 1097 of 2015
Hon'ble Rajiv Sharma, J.
Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. B.S. Parihar, Standing Counsel for
the State.
Heard.
Petitioner was appointed as Beldar on
21.05.1988. Petitioner was conferred the
work-charge status. Thereafter, he was
regularized w.e.f. 01.07.2006 vide order dated
11.07.2006. The persons junior to the
petitioner who were appointed after petitioner
were regularized w.e.f. 12.08.2005.
The persons junior to the petitioner
could not be regularized before the petitioner.
There is arbitrariness in the action of the
respondents by regularizing the petitioner
w.e.f. 01.07.2006 and the persons junior to
the petitioner w.e.f 12.08.2005. There is
violation of Articles 14 and 16 of the
Constitution of India.
The effect of regularizing the petitioner
w.e.f. 2006 has resulted in denial of pension to
him as per the old pension rules.
Accordingly, the writ petition is allowed
with a declaration that the petitioner would
also be deemed to be in service on regular
basis from the date persons junior to the
petitioner i.e. 2005 with all consequential
benefits. The case of the petitioner shall also
be considered for pension according to the old
pension scheme.
Pending application, if any, also stands
disposed of.
